Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE VII OF 2001
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE VII OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Local
Government Elections Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of N.W.F.P., Extraordinary, 4th June,
2001]
No. Legis. 1(18)70/2966/2996, dated 4-6-2001.--The following
Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance tray be called
the North-West Frontier Province Local Government Elections (Amendment)
Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Local Government Elections Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Amendment of section 10 of N.W.F.P. Ordinance No. VI of 2000

ORDINANCE VII OF 2001
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE VII OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Local
Government Elections Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of N.W.F.P., Extraordinary, 4th June,
2001]
No. Legis. 1(18)70/2966/2996, dated 4-6-2001.--The following
Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province is hereby
published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 10 of N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No. VI of 2000.--In
the North-West Frontier Province Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000
(N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No. VI of 2000). in section 10, in subsection (2), for the
words "all the members of union councils" the words "all the
notified returned candidates for the seats of union councils in the elections
held under this Ordinance" shall be substituted.
